source.title: 量子力学习题解（曾谨言）
source.pdf_file: 量子力学：习题解-曾谨言.pdf

raw_problem.problem_text:
一体系在无微扰时有两条能级，其中一条时二重简并，在 $H _ { 0 }$ 表象中

$$
H _ {0} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & E _ {1} ^ {(0)} \end{array} \right) \quad E _ {2} ^ {(0)} > E _ {1} ^ {(0)} \tag {1}
$$

在计及微扰后哈密顿量表示为：

$$
H = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & 0 & a \\ 0 & E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & b \\ a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} & E _ {2} ^ {(0)} \end{array} \right) \tag {2}
$$

（1） 用微扰论求 H 本征值准到二级近似。  
（2） 把 $H$ 严格对角化，求 H 的精确本征值，然后
raw_problem.solution_text:
（1）将 H， $H$ '比较知道

$$
H ^ {\prime} = H - H _ {0} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & a \\ 0 & 0 & b \\ a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) \tag {3}
$$

本题的微扰矩阵（3）是简并的波函数（零级）计算得来的，若像无简并微扰论那样计算二级能量修正是可能的，但近似程度差，从（3）看出一级能量修正为零，准确到二级修正量的能量本征值是：

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {1} = E _ {1} ^ {(0)} + \frac {\left| a \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}, E _ {1} ^ {\prime} = E _ {1} ^ {(0)} + \frac {\left| b \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}, \\ E _ {2} = E _ {2} ^ {(0)} + \frac {\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}} \\ \end{array}
$$

$\sim 3 8 9 \sim$

但若将（2）看作准确的包括微扰的算符看待，则又能用分立表象本征函数的矩阵解法，设定一个本征矢（三个元素的单列矩阵）和一个本征值 ，方程式是

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & 0 & a \\ 0 & E _ {1} ^ {(0)} & b \\ a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} & E _ {2} ^ {(0)} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{l} c _ {1} \\ c _ {2} \\ c _ {3} \end{array} \right) = \lambda \left( \begin{array}{l} c _ {1} \\ c _ {2} \\ c _ {3} \end{array} \right) \\ \text {即} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} {{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - \lambda}} & {{0}} & {{a}} \\ {{0}} & {{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - \lambda}} & {{b}} \\ {{a ^ {*}}} & {{b ^ {*}}} & {{E _ {2} ^ {(0)} - \lambda}} \end{array} \right) \binom {c _ {1}} {c _ {2}} = 0 \\ \end{array}
$$

久期方程式是：

$$
\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - \lambda\right) ^ {2} \left(E _ {2} ^ {(0)} - \lambda\right) - \left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right) \left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - \lambda\right) = 0
$$

变形： $( \lambda - E _ { 1 } ^ { ( 0 ) } ) [ \lambda ^ { 2 } - ( E _ { 1 } ^ { ( 0 ) } + E _ { 2 } ^ { ( 0 ) } ) \lambda + E _ { 1 } ^ { ( 0 ) } E _ { 2 } ^ { ( 0 ) } - \left| a \right| ^ { 2 } - \left| b \right| ^ { 2 } ] = 0$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \lambda_ {1} = E _ {1} ^ {(0)} \quad \lambda_ {2}, \lambda_ {3} = \frac {E _ {1} ^ {(0)} + E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}{2} \pm \sqrt {\frac {\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {2}}{4} + \left| a \right| ^ {2} - \left| b \right| ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {E _ {1} ^ {(0)} + E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}{2} \pm \frac {E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}{2} \left\{1 + \frac {2 \left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right)}{\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {2}} - \frac {2 \left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {4}} + \dots \dots \right\} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\lambda_ {2} = E _ {1} ^ {(0)} + \frac {\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}} - \frac {\left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {3}} + \dots \dots
$$

$$
\lambda_ {3} = E _ {2} ^ {(0)} - \frac {\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}} + \frac {\left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {3}} + \dots \dots \quad \sim 3 9 0
$$

可以和前一种近似解比较（与前题类似）其误差

$$
\Delta E _ {1} = \Delta E _ {1} ^ {\prime} <   \frac {\left| b ^ {2} \right|}{E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}}
$$

$$
\Delta E _ {2} <   \frac {\left(\left| a \right| ^ {2} + \left| b \right| ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(E _ {1} ^ {(0)} - E _ {2} ^ {(0)}\right) ^ {2}}
$$

#
